[[File:Mithril battleaxe detail.png|left|130px]]
A '''mithril battleaxe''' is a [[battleaxe]] made from 3 [[mithril bar]]s, requiring 60 [[Smithing]], yielding 150 Smithing [[experience]]. 20 [[Attack]] is required to wield it. It is stronger than the [[black battleaxe]], but weaker than the [[adamant battleaxe]].

Players can purchase it from [[Brian's Battleaxe Bazaar]] in [[Port Sarim]], [[Bob's Brilliant Axes]] in [[Lumbridge]], or [[Gulluck and Sons]] in the [[Tree Gnome Stronghold]].
